name: horka-research-plan
description: Multi-agent research that ends in a sourced action plan: reality check (prod / develop / open PRs), personas and real-demand probe first, researchers briefed per action type, independent validators that open every URL, antagonist critic, feasibility and completeness pass, delivered as a single doc-style HTML page. Ends with a retrospective by a separate agent that rewrites a lessons file, read again at the start of the next run. No number without a source, no agent grading its own work.
